description: Canonical NVMe opcode reference — NVMe Base Spec 2.0a, Figures 145 (Admin) and 173-ish (NVM Command Set). This table is the single source of truth for which opcodes/commands exist; it is intentionally separate from kb/commands/*.json, which holds the DETAILED per-command KB (SQ layout, status rules, response structure) used to actually build/predict commands. A command can appear here without yet having a detailed KB entry — the pipeline reports that distinction explicitly rather than treating it as 'unknown command'.
_note: Opcode values above are transcribed from memory of NVMe Base Spec 2.0a and have NOT been independently re-verified page-by-page in this session. Treat this table the same way as anything generate_kb_from_docs.py produces: a draft to check against your actual spec PDF before relying on it for anything safety- or correctness-critical.
